newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar in quiet market.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar but weakened versus the pound on Monday in a quiet local forex market which was following international trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 19.911 for one dollar from 19.925 last Friday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean of 33.6425 from 33.3740 on Friday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing was done in line with the dollar's overnight movement in international markets.
"There is practically no activity in the foreign exchange market. And we are not expecting anything before next year," one forex dealer said.
